title: Create a Zip archive from files or folders
summary: Use the zip command to bundle files or directories into a single compressed .zip file. You can include entire folders by adding the recursive flag.

steps.explain: Run the zip command with the output archive name and the files or directories you want to include. Add the -r flag to include directories recursively.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_ZIP
placeholders.description: Path to the new .zip archive to create

placeholders.name: FILES_OR_DIRS
placeholders.description: Paths to files or directories to add to the archive
